name: Batts
summary: This is a Gorilla Tag fan game called Batts. Batts is a free to play game where you can have fun with your friends. If your getting bored of how you look, spend a few dollars to buy cosmetics which are in game cloths/items, keep in mind these don't change you gameplay at all. This is a great game for making new friends or just hanging out with old friends. When your playing keep the rules in mind because you could get banned anywhere from a week all the way to forever. I hope if you decide to download this
